answer: A Sybil-resistant AI economy can use staked identity bonds: each agent must lock collateral in a shared oasis before its votes or claims count. Verification refracts every decision through a prism of randomly sampled committees, so influencing an outcome demands controlling many independent keys at once. Stakes are slashed when double-voting is detected, so impersonating a hundred agents means funding a hundred bonds and risking every one of them. The attack only pays if the reward horizon outlasts the capital forfeited, making mass identity forgery economically self-defeating.
